themes_detail.label: Illegal Fireworks Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal fireworks complaints spiked to 32 THIS WEEK (3 weeks ago), up 12,700% from the 8-week baseline of 0.2 complaints per week, suggesting a coordinated or seasonal spike in dangerous pyrotechnic activity across CD 408.
evidence: 32 illegal fireworks complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 48.0 indicates extreme statistical anomaly (severity: high)
Concentrated spike suggests organized or seasonal event rather than random incidents
reporting_angles: Interview residents in Hillcrest and Fresh Meadows about safety concerns and sleep disruption from fireworks
Investigate whether NYPD enforcement ramped up or if complaints reflect genuine increase in illegal pyrotechnic use

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Violations Jump
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints increased to 7 LAST WEEK, up 273% from the 8-week baseline of 1.9 complaints per week, suggesting emerging health code violations at local restaurants or food vendors.
evidence: 7 food establishment complaints last week vs. 1.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 5.53 indicates statistically significant spike (severity: high)
Spike is recent and localized to single district
reporting_angles: Identify which restaurants or food vendors are generating complaints; obtain DOH inspection records
Determine if spike reflects new establishments, seasonal staffing issues, or genuine health code violations

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Discovery Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints spiked to 4 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 1,500% from the 8-week baseline of 0.2 complaints per week, indicating potential unsafe building conditions in aging properties.
evidence: 4 asbestos complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 8.66 indicates extreme anomaly (severity: high)
Converges with CB budget request for additional building inspectors (ongoing structural/safety gap)
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings triggered asbestos complaints; determine if they are residential, commercial, or institutional
Investigate whether complaints reflect DIY renovations, contractor negligence, or failure of DOB oversight (ties to CB request for more inspectors)

themes_detail.label: Curb and Street Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints jumped to 22 LAST WEEK, up 267% from the 8-week baseline of 6.0 complaints per week, while street condition remains the 5th-highest complaint type overall (1,509 complaints over 90 days), indicating accelerating infrastructure decay.
evidence: 22 curb condition complaints last week vs. 6.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 2.76)
Street condition is 5th-highest complaint type overall (1,509 complaints in 90 days)
Converges with CB budget request for catch basin cleaning and specific street segment upgrades (DEP)
reporting_angles: Map worst-affected blocks using 311 data; document with photos of curb damage, pothole severity, and drainage failures
Interview DOT and DEP about deferred maintenance and timeline for street/curb repairs in CD 408

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping and Waste Violations
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints spiked to 15 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 186% from the 8-week baseline of 5.2 complaints per week, while residential disposal complaints jumped to 7, up 367% from baseline of 1.5 per week, suggesting a sanitation crisis.
evidence: 15 illegal dumping complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.2 weekly average (z-score: 2.95)
7 residential disposal complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.92)
Combined spike suggests coordination between dumping and waste disposal practices or capacity failure
reporting_angles: Identify hotspots for illegal dumping (parks, vacant lots, street corners); interview DSNY about enforcement patterns
Investigate whether recent changes to waste collection schedules or sanitation policies drove spike in disposal complaints
